action: Call Amir Patel by phone this morning. Not email. Phone. Confirm whether the outstanding business cash flow documentation has been submitted. If yes, immediately notify the underwriting desk and push for final approval by end of week. If no, give Amir a clear, direct 48-hour deadline: the document needs to be in my hands by end of business tomorrow or the conditional approval lapses and we restart. I am not his accountant and I am not chasing him indefinitely — but this loan is one piece of paper from closing and I need that fee income. I tell him that plainly: we are at the finish line, I need this document to get you the capital you applied for. Make it easy for him to say yes.
